blocks.zh: 驗證流程總覽與驗證前準備活動
blocks.en: The Validation Process Overview and Pre-Validation Activities

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 AMM/RMM 驗證應以生命週期 (lifecycle) 觀點進行，而不只是一次性的初始驗證研究，並掌握 Table 5.0-1 所呈現的整體驗證與確效交付項目及供應商／終端使用者的責任分工
blocks.en: Understand that AMM/RMM validation should be approached from a lifecycle perspective rather than as a one-time initial validation study, and know the overall validation and qualification deliverables shown in Table 5.0-1 together with the division of responsibilities between supplier and end user

blocks.zh: 掌握 Pre-Validation（驗證前活動）七大關鍵環節：Proof of Concept (POC)、User Requirements Specifications (URS)、供應商能力評估／稽核、ROI 商業效益評估、風險評估與驗證規劃、Design Qualification (DQ)、Validation Master Plan (VMP)
blocks.en: Master the seven key elements of Pre-Validation: Proof of Concept (POC), User Requirements Specifications (URS), supplier capability assessment/audit, ROI business benefit assessment, risk assessment and validation planning, Design Qualification (DQ) and the Validation Master Plan (VMP)

blocks.zh: 熟悉 URS 與 Supplier Audit 如何決定後續驗證策略與允收標準（Acceptance Criteria）的建立，以及 Master File 在法規申報中的角色
blocks.en: Be familiar with how the URS and the supplier audit drive the subsequent validation strategy and the setting of acceptance criteria, and with the role of the Master File in regulatory submissions

blocks.zh: 能運用 ROI／財務模型評估導入新方法的商業效益，並理解 VMP 在整體驗證架構中承先啟後的角色（銜接 IQ/OQ/PQ 與 Method Validation）
blocks.en: Be able to use ROI/financial models to evaluate the business benefit of adopting a new method, and understand the VMP as the link between what comes before and after it (bridging IQ/OQ/PQ and method validation)

blocks.zh: 5.0 The Validation Process 驗證流程總覽
blocks.en: 5.0 The Validation Process: Overview

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Validation (驗證) 的現代定義：ICH Q2(R2) 的傳統定義著重於「證明方法適用其預期目的」，但 TR 33 特別強調現代法規觀點下，驗證是一個生命週期活動 (lifecycle activity)——不是做完一次驗證研究就結束，而是要在日常例行使用（routine use）期間持續確保方法效能。
blocks.en: The modern definition of validation: The traditional ICH Q2(R2) definition focuses on "demonstrating that a method is suitable for its intended purpose", but TR 33 specifically stresses the modern regulatory view that validation is a lifecycle activity. It is not finished once a validation study has been performed; method performance must continue to be assured throughout routine use.

blocks.zh: Qualitative (定性) vs. Quantitative (定量)：AMM/RMM 依驗證目的可分為定性方法（例如 presence/absence 有無菌檢測）與定量方法（例如 enumeration 菌落計數），兩者所需的驗證準則（accuracy、LoD、LoQ 等）並不相同，後續 Section 5.4 會逐項展開。
blocks.en: Qualitative vs. quantitative: Depending on the purpose of validation, AMM/RMM can be divided into qualitative methods (for example, presence/absence sterility testing) and quantitative methods (for example, enumeration by colony counting). The validation criteria they require (accuracy, LoD, LoQ and so on) differ, and Section 5.4 develops them one by one.

blocks.zh: 跨法規調和：原文點出 USP ⟨1223⟩ 與 Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 在術語、流程、資料判讀、允收標準與統計方法上存在細微差異；TR 33 的目標是提供一套能被所有地區法規機關接受、且具科學可辯護性 (scientifically defendable) 的策略，減少企業因地區法規不同而重複驗證的負擔。
blocks.en: Harmonization across regulations: The source points out that USP ⟨1223⟩ and Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 differ subtly in terminology, process, data interpretation, acceptance criteria and statistical methods. TR 33 aims to provide a strategy that is acceptable to all regional regulatory authorities and scientifically defendable, reducing the burden on companies of repeating validation because regional requirements differ.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把驗證想像成取得駕照後仍需定期換照、體檢與路測：考到駕照那一刻（初始驗證研究）只代表你當下具備開車能力，但監理機關仍要求定期換照、視力檢查（持續確效），確保你在往後每一天上路時都維持足夠的能力與安全性。同樣地，AMM/RMM 通過初始驗證後，並不代表永遠合格——必須在生命週期中持續監控、變更管理與再驗證，才能確保方法始終可靠。
blocks.en: Think of validation as renewing a driver's license and having regular medical and road tests after you have passed: the moment you pass the driving test (the initial validation study) only shows that you were able to drive at that time, but the authority still requires periodic renewal and eyesight checks (ongoing validation) to make sure you keep sufficient ability and safety every day you are on the road. Likewise, an AMM/RMM that has passed its initial validation is not qualified forever. Continuous monitoring, change management and revalidation across the lifecycle are needed to keep the method reliable.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 原文特別建議「及早（early）」與法規機關溝通驗證與導入策略——這與 Section 3.3 一貫的立場一致：AMM/RMM 的驗證資源投入極大，若等到驗證完成才與法規機關討論可接受性，一旦法規機關有不同見解，將導致龐大的重工成本與時程延誤。這也呼應本知識庫的決策優先序：法規可接受性與科學可辯護性必須在投入資源前就先確認。
blocks.en: The source specifically recommends communicating with regulatory authorities "early" about the validation and implementation strategy. This is consistent with the position taken throughout Section 3.3: AMM/RMM validation demands a very large investment of resources, and if acceptability is only discussed with the regulator after validation is complete, any differing view from the authority will lead to heavy rework and schedule delays. It also reflects the decision priority of this knowledge base: regulatory acceptability and scientific defensibility must be confirmed before resources are committed.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 「Validation is understood as a lifecycle activity」這句話，對 Amaran 已完成驗證的 AMM/RMM 方法，在日常操作中應該有哪些具體的持續確效活動？
blocks.en: What ongoing validation activities should be carried out during routine operation for an AMM/RMM method that Amaran has already validated, given the statement "Validation is understood as a lifecycle activity"?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP ⟨1223⟩ 與 Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 之間的差異，會讓「一套策略適用所有地區」變得困難？你能舉出可能的差異點嗎？
blocks.en: Why do the differences between USP ⟨1223⟩ and Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 make it difficult to have "one strategy for all regions"? Can you give examples of where they might differ?

blocks.zh: 若你正在評估導入一套新的 AMM/RMM，你會在驗證流程的哪個階段主動聯繫 TFDA 或其他監管機關進行溝通？
blocks.en: If you were evaluating a new AMM/RMM for adoption, at which stage of the validation process would you proactively contact TFDA or another regulatory authority?

blocks.zh: 表格解讀 Table Takeaway
blocks.en: Table Takeaway

blocks.zh: 這張表是 Section 5.0 的導覽地圖，一次呈現整個驗證流程從「驗證前活動」到「日常維護」的全貌，並清楚標示每項交付物由供應商 (Supplier) 或終端使用者 (End User) 負責執行、支援或審查。留意兩個重點：① 多數項目呈現「Review and assess ... or Execute」的結構——代表終端使用者原則上可以「審查供應商已完成的研究」來取代自己重做，但若供應商未執行、或方法/參數與供應商原始驗證不同，終端使用者仍須自行執行；② 表格中標示的章節編號（例如 POC 對應 5.1.2、URS 對應 5.1.3、DQ 對應 5.1.7）與本文實際小節編號（5.1.1 Proof of Concept、5.1.2 URS、5.1.6 Design Qualification、5.1.7 Validation Master Plan）之間存在一碼之差的編號落差，這是原文件本身的編排差異，並非翻譯或抄錄錯誤——研讀時請以本節內文小節標題（5.1.1-5.1.7）為準，此表僅作整體流程對照之用。本節（5.0-5.1）僅涵蓋表格中前四列（POC、URS、Supplier Audit/Business Case/Risk Assessment、DQ）以及 VMP 的定義；IQ/OQ/PQ、Primary Validation、Method Suitability、Comparability 與 Ongoing Maintenance 將於後續章節（5.2-5.4）詳述。
blocks.en: This table is the navigation map for Section 5.0. It presents the whole validation process at a glance, from "pre-validation activities" to "routine maintenance", and clearly shows whether each deliverable is performed, supported or reviewed by the Supplier or the End User. Note two points: (1) Most items follow a "Review and assess ... or Execute" structure, meaning that in principle the end user may "review the studies the supplier has already completed" instead of repeating them, but must still perform the work itself if the supplier has not done it or if the method/parameters differ from the supplier's original validation; (2) The section numbers shown in the table (for example POC at 5.1.2, URS at 5.1.3, DQ at 5.1.7) are off by one from the actual subsection numbers in the text (5.1.1 Proof of Concept, 5.1.2 URS, 5.1.6 Design Qualification, 5.1.7 Validation Master Plan). This is a numbering discrepancy in the original document itself and not a translation or transcription error. When studying, follow the subsection headings in this section (5.1.1-5.1.7) and use the table only as an overall process reference. This section (5.0-5.1) covers only the first four rows of the table (POC, URS, Supplier Audit/Business Case/Risk Assessment, DQ) and the definition of the VMP; IQ/OQ/PQ, Primary Validation, Method Suitability, Comparability and Ongoing Maintenance are discussed in later sections (5.2-5.4).

blocks.zh: 5.1 Pre-Validation Activities 驗證前準備活動
blocks.en: 5.1 Pre-Validation Activities

blocks.zh: Pre-Validation Activities (驗證前活動)：正式驗證（IQ/OQ/PQ、Method Validation）開始之前，先完成的一系列準備工作。這些工作雖然發生在「驗證」正式啟動之前，但品質卻直接決定後續驗證能否一次到位。
blocks.en: Pre-Validation Activities: The series of preparatory tasks completed before formal validation (IQ/OQ/PQ, method validation) begins. Although they take place before "validation" formally starts, their quality directly determines whether the subsequent validation can be completed right the first time.

blocks.zh: 為什麼要先做這些準備？原文明確指出，做好驗證前活動可以「reduce the number of deviations and amount of retesting」——換言之，這不是可有可無的行政流程，而是實質降低驗證失敗風險、節省時間與成本的關鍵投資。
blocks.en: Why do this preparation first? The source states clearly that good pre-validation activities can "reduce the number of deviations and amount of retesting". In other words, this is not optional administrative work but a key investment that materially lowers the risk of validation failure and saves time and cost.

blocks.zh: 驗證前活動就像手術前的術前評估與知情同意：外科醫師不會在病人一送進手術室就直接開刀，而是先確認病人病史、進行影像檢查、確認手術方案可行（相當於 POC）、與病人及家屬明確討論手術範圍與限制（相當於 URS）。這些「手術前」步驟做得愈確實，正式手術（正式驗證）時發生意外併發症（deviation）與重新開刀（retesting）的機率就愈低。
blocks.en: Pre-validation activities are like the pre-operative assessment and informed consent before surgery: a surgeon does not operate the moment the patient is wheeled into the operating room. The surgeon first confirms the medical history, performs imaging, and confirms that the surgical plan is feasible (equivalent to POC), and discusses the scope and limits of the operation clearly with the patient and family (equivalent to URS). The more thoroughly these "pre-surgery" steps are done, the lower the chance of unexpected complications (deviations) and repeat operations (retesting) during the actual surgery (formal validation).

blocks.zh: 原文對供應商的責任界定得很清楚：供應商必須提供技術描述、微生物偵測的科學原理、預期用途、所需材料設備，以及偵測/計數/鑑別微生物時的預期資料輸出或訊號型態。這代表 CDMO 在評估任何 AMM/RMM 供應商時，若對方無法清楚回答上述任一項，即是一個警訊（red flag），應在正式簽約與驗證投入前釐清。
blocks.en: The source defines the supplier's responsibilities clearly: the supplier must provide a technical description, the scientific principle of microbial detection, the intended use, the materials and equipment required, and the expected data output or signal pattern when detecting, enumerating or identifying microorganisms. This means that when a CDMO evaluates any AMM/RMM supplier, failure to answer any of these points clearly is a red flag and should be clarified before contracting and committing validation effort.

blocks.zh: 如果供應商無法提供「預期資料輸出或訊號型態」的清楚說明，你認為這對後續驗證規劃會造成什麼具體風險？
blocks.en: If the supplier cannot clearly explain the "expected data output or signal pattern", what specific risks do you think this creates for subsequent validation planning?

blocks.zh: 「Deviations」與「Retesting」在驗證活動中通常會造成哪些實際成本（時間、人力、財務）？
blocks.en: What real costs (time, manpower, financial) do "deviations" and "retesting" usually cause in validation activities?

blocks.zh: 5.1.1 Proof of Concept 概念驗證
blocks.en: 5.1.1 Proof of Concept

blocks.zh: Proof of Concept, POC (概念驗證)：在正式決定採購設備／儀器之前，先進行的初步可行性評估，確認方法與伴隨系統是否與預期產品或樣品基質（sample matrix）相容。POC 回答的核心問題是：「這個方法原理上『行得通』嗎？」
blocks.en: Proof of Concept, POC: A preliminary feasibility assessment performed before the decision to purchase equipment/instruments, to confirm that the method and its accompanying system are compatible with the intended product or sample matrix. The core question POC answers is: "Can this method work in principle?"

blocks.zh: 何時最需要 POC？原文明確指出：當供應商沒有類似產品、樣品基質或常規微生物種類的支持性數據時，POC 最為關鍵——換言之，POC 的必要性與供應商既有數據的涵蓋範圍成反比。
blocks.en: When is POC most needed? The source states clearly that POC is most critical when the supplier does not have supporting data for similar products, sample matrices or routine microbial species. In other words, the need for POC is inversely proportional to the coverage of the supplier's existing data.

blocks.zh: POC 就像買車前的試駕：你不會在完全沒試駕過的情況下，直接簽約買下一台從未在你常走的山路、載重需求下測試過的車款。試駕（POC）讓你在花大錢（正式採購與驗證投入）之前，先確認這台車（AMM/RMM）在你實際使用情境（你的產品基質、常見菌種）下是否真的能穩定運作。
blocks.en: POC is like a test drive before buying a car: you would not sign a contract for a model that has never been tested on the mountain roads you normally drive or under your load requirements. The test drive (POC) lets you confirm, before spending a lot of money (formal purchase and validation effort), that the car (AMM/RMM) really works reliably under your actual conditions of use (your product matrix, your common organisms).

blocks.zh: POC 的執行者可以是終端使用者，也可以是供應商——這點在 Table 5.0-1 中也有呼應（「Execute upon request of end user」或「Review and assess ... or Execute」）。實務上，若供應商已針對相似產品類型累積足夠數據，終端使用者可選擇「審查供應商既有 POC/primary validation 資料」而非重新執行，藉此節省時間與成本，但前提是供應商數據必須涵蓋終端使用者實際的產品基質與菌種範圍。
blocks.en: POC can be performed by the end user or by the supplier, as echoed in Table 5.0-1 ("Execute upon request of end user" or "Review and assess ... or Execute"). In practice, if the supplier has accumulated enough data on similar product types, the end user may choose to "review the supplier's existing POC/primary validation data" instead of re-executing it, saving time and cost, provided that the supplier's data cover the end user's actual product matrix and range of organisms.

blocks.zh: 若 Amaran 預計為一項新的 ATMP/核醫產品導入新的 AMM/RMM，而供應商過去只有傳統小分子針劑的驗證數據，你認為是否需要執行 POC？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: If Amaran plans to introduce a new AMM/RMM for a new ATMP/radiopharmaceutical product and the supplier has only validation data for conventional small-molecule injectables, do you think a POC needs to be performed? What is your reasoning?

blocks.zh: POC 測試中「產品或樣品基質」與「菌種選擇」為何必須「carefully selected」？如果選擇不當，可能造成什麼後果？
blocks.en: Why must the "product or sample matrix" and the "organism selection" in a POC test be "carefully selected"? What consequences might follow if they are chosen poorly?

blocks.zh: 5.1.2 User Requirements Specifications 使用者需求規格書
blocks.en: 5.1.2 User Requirements Specifications

blocks.zh: User Requirements Specifications, URS (使用者需求規格書)：明確描述方法在日常例行使用（routine use）時所需具備特性的關鍵文件。URS 通常由終端使用者撰寫，但應納入 Regulatory Affairs（法規事務）、Quality（品質）、Information Technology（資訊技術）等內部利害關係人及潛在供應商的意見。
blocks.en: User Requirements Specifications, URS: The key document that clearly describes the characteristics the method must have in routine use. The URS is usually written by the end user, but should incorporate input from internal stakeholders such as Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Information Technology, as well as potential suppliers.

blocks.zh: External Specification / Supplier URS：供應商自己針對其系統撰寫的規格文件。將供應商 URS 與終端使用者 URS 交叉比對，能找出雙方各自遺漏、但可能屬於關鍵效能特性的項目（例如 throughput 產能、automation 自動化程度、LIMS 介面）。
blocks.en: External Specification / Supplier URS: The specification document the supplier writes for its own system. Cross-checking the supplier URS against the end-user URS can reveal items that each side has missed but that may be critical performance characteristics (for example throughput, degree of automation, LIMS interface).

blocks.zh: URS 就像建案的「客戶需求規格書」：屋主（終端使用者）列出格局、坪數、採光、管線配置等需求，但也必須參考建商（供應商）提供的「建材規格表」，交叉比對才能發現屋主沒想到、但很關鍵的細節（例如消防法規、結構載重）。URS 品質不佳，等於一開始就把房子（方法/系統）的設計圖畫錯，後續無論怎麼施工（驗證）都很難補救。
blocks.en: The URS is like the "customer requirements specification" for a building project: the owner (end user) lists requirements such as layout, floor area, daylighting and piping, but must also consult the "materials specification sheet" provided by the builder (supplier). Cross-checking the two reveals details the owner had not thought of but that are critical (for example fire codes and structural loads). A poor-quality URS means the design drawings for the house (method/system) are wrong from the start, and no amount of construction (validation) can easily fix that afterwards.

blocks.zh: 原文用了很強烈的字眼：URS 的內容「may well determine the success or failure of the method selection process」——URS 品質直接決定方法選型成敗。更關鍵的是：URS 是建立驗證準則（validation criteria）與允收標準（acceptance criteria）的起點。也就是說，URS 寫得含糊或不完整，後續整個驗證策略（Validation Master Plan、IQ/OQ/PQ、Method Validation）都會失去明確的判定基準——這是驗證前活動中最容易被低估、卻影響最深遠的一步。
blocks.en: The source uses very strong wording: the content of the URS "may well determine the success or failure of the method selection process", so URS quality directly decides whether the method selection succeeds. More importantly, the URS is the starting point for establishing validation criteria and acceptance criteria. If the URS is vague or incomplete, the entire subsequent validation strategy (Validation Master Plan, IQ/OQ/PQ, method validation) loses a clear basis for judgment. This is the pre-validation step that is most easily underestimated yet has the most far-reaching impact.

blocks.zh: 撰寫 URS 時為何要邀請 Regulatory Affairs、Quality、IT 等不同部門一起參與，而非只讓實驗室人員自行撰寫？
blocks.en: Why should Regulatory Affairs, Quality, IT and other departments be invited to take part in writing the URS, rather than leaving it to laboratory staff alone?

blocks.zh: 如果終端使用者的 URS 與供應商的 External Specification 之間發生衝突（例如供應商規格未涵蓋你要求的 LIMS 介面），你會如何處理？
blocks.en: If the end user's URS conflicts with the supplier's External Specification (for example, the supplier specification does not cover the LIMS interface you require), how would you handle it?

blocks.zh: 為什麼原文說 URS 會「directly influence the entire strategy for validation and acceptance criteria」？請舉一個因 URS 描述不清而導致驗證準則模糊的例子。
blocks.en: Why does the source say the URS will "directly influence the entire strategy for validation and acceptance criteria"? Give an example in which an unclear URS led to vague validation criteria.

blocks.zh: 5.1.3 Assessment of Supplier Capabilities/Supplier Audit 供應商能力評估／稽核
blocks.en: 5.1.3 Assessment of Supplier Capabilities/Supplier Audit

blocks.zh: Supplier Audit (供應商稽核)：透過文件審查與／或實地稽核，評估供應商是否具備符合終端使用者內部品質要求與優良實務指引的能力。稽核重點涵蓋品質系統、財務穩定性、供貨穩定性、技術支援、教育訓練與軟體更新管理等十大面向。
blocks.en: Supplier Audit: Evaluating, through document review and/or an on-site audit, whether the supplier is capable of meeting the end user's internal quality requirements and good practice guidance. The audit focuses on ten areas, including the quality system, financial stability, supply continuity, technical support, training and software update management.

blocks.zh: Master File (主檔案)：供應商向 FDA 提交、內容機密且僅 FDA 可存取的技術效能資訊檔案，常包含專屬技術資訊或驗證研究數據（例如 ruggedness、robustness 研究）。終端使用者可請供應商出具授權信（letter of authorization），讓 FDA 在審查終端使用者的申報案時參照該 Master File，藉此補強自己的申報資料。
blocks.en: Master File: A confidential file of technical performance information that the supplier submits to FDA and that only FDA can access. It often contains proprietary technical information or validation study data (for example ruggedness and robustness studies). The end user can ask the supplier for a letter of authorization allowing FDA to reference the Master File when reviewing the end user's submission, thereby supporting its own filing.

blocks.zh: 供應商稽核就像CDMO 選擇原料藥（API）供應商前的供應商資格認證 (Vendor Qualification)：不會只看報價單就下單，而是要實地稽核對方的品質系統、財務體質、供貨穩定性與應變能力。Master File 則像是供應商向政府機關預先存放的一份「機密身家調查報告」——一般人（其他終端使用者）看不到內容，但當你（終端使用者）需要時，可以請供應商授權讓 FDA「調閱」這份報告來佐證你自己的申報案，而不必要求供應商把機密技術細節直接交給你。
blocks.en: A supplier audit is like the vendor qualification a CDMO performs before selecting an active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) supplier: you do not place an order on the price quote alone, but audit the other party's quality system, financial strength, supply stability and ability to respond to problems on site. The Master File is like a confidential "background investigation report" the supplier has pre-deposited with a government agency: ordinary people (other end users) cannot see its contents, but when you (the end user) need it, you can ask the supplier to authorize FDA to "retrieve" the report in support of your own submission, without requiring the supplier to hand the confidential technical details directly to you.

blocks.zh: 原文特別提醒：EMA 等其他法規機關可能沒有 Master File 機制——這代表全球多地區申報策略（例如同時面對 FDA 與 EMA/TFDA）不能假設「有 Master File 就一勞永逸」，在沒有對等機制的地區，終端使用者可能需要直接向供應商取得驗證數據並納入自己的驗證套件（validation package）。這對多地區布局的 CDMO 而言，是規劃供應商溝通策略時必須提前確認的實務細節。
blocks.en: The source specifically cautions that other authorities such as EMA may not have a Master File mechanism. This means a multi-region filing strategy (for example facing FDA and EMA/TFDA at the same time) cannot assume that "having a Master File settles everything". In regions without an equivalent mechanism, the end user may need to obtain the validation data directly from the supplier and include them in its own validation package. For a CDMO operating in multiple regions, this is a practical detail to confirm early when planning the supplier communication strategy.

blocks.zh: 在稽核清單十大面向中，哪一項你認為對臨床階段無菌充填 CDMO 最關鍵？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the ten areas on the audit checklist, which do you think is most critical for a clinical-stage sterile filling CDMO, and why?

blocks.zh: 如果供應商無法提供財務穩定性佐證，這對長期合作（例如未來 10 年的耗材與軟體更新支援）會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: If the supplier cannot provide evidence of financial stability, what risks does this pose for a long-term relationship (for example, consumables and software update support over the next 10 years)?

blocks.zh: 當你需要向 TFDA（而非 FDA）申報使用某 AMM/RMM，而該供應商僅有 FDA Master File、沒有對等的 TFDA 機制時，你會如何取得所需的驗證支持資料？
blocks.en: When you need to file with TFDA (rather than FDA) to use an AMM/RMM and the supplier has only an FDA Master File with no equivalent TFDA mechanism, how would you obtain the validation supporting data you need?

blocks.zh: 5.1.4 Business Benefits or Return-on-Investment Considerations 商業效益與投資報酬率考量
blocks.en: 5.1.4 Business Benefits or Return-on-Investment Considerations

blocks.zh: Return-on-Investment, ROI (投資報酬率) 分析：在完成 POC 評估與其他驗證前活動、確認技術適用性後，用以支持或佐證採購設備及其後續驗證/導入商業案（business case）的財務分析工具。原文明確交叉參照 Section 3.4（Business and Quality Considerations），代表 ROI 評估並非本節新概念，而是延續前面章節已建立的財務評估框架。
blocks.en: Return-on-Investment (ROI) analysis: A financial analysis tool used, after the POC assessment and other pre-validation activities have confirmed technical suitability, to support or substantiate the business case for purchasing the equipment and subsequently validating/implementing it. The source explicitly cross-references Section 3.4 (Business and Quality Considerations), which shows that ROI assessment is not a new concept in this section but a continuation of the financial evaluation framework already established in earlier sections.

blocks.zh: 時序上的關鍵原則：「The final instrument selection and purchase should, of course, take place before initiating validation」——設備選型與採購必須在正式驗證啟動之前完成，驗證的對象是已經確定採購的設備/方法，而非驗證過程中還在猶豫的候選方案。
blocks.en: The key principle on timing: "The final instrument selection and purchase should, of course, take place before initiating validation". Equipment selection and purchase must be completed before formal validation starts; what is validated is equipment/a method that has already been decided upon, not a candidate still under deliberation during validation.

blocks.zh: 這就像買房前的「議價與簽約」必須在「裝潢設計定案」之前完成：你不會邊裝潢邊猶豫要不要買這間房子。同理，POC 與技術適用性評估、ROI 財務論證，都應該在「正式驗證（相當於裝潢施工）」開始之前就拍板定案——一旦驗證啟動，代表企業已經對這套 AMM/RMM 下了明確的採購決策。
blocks.en: This is like "negotiating and signing the contract" for a house having to be completed before "the interior design is finalized": you would not hesitate over whether to buy the house while renovating it. In the same way, the POC and technical suitability assessment and the ROI financial justification should all be settled before formal validation (the equivalent of renovation work) begins. Once validation starts, the company has made a definite purchase decision for this AMM/RMM.

blocks.zh: 本節雖然簡短，但呼應了 Section 3.4 的核心提醒：ROI／財務分析只是決策輸入之一，技術適用性（technical appropriateness）必須先確認，財務效益再好，若技術上不適用於預期用途，也不應貿為導入。這再次體現決策優先序：① 無菌保證與產品 CQA → ② 技術適用性 → ③ 商業效益（ROI）。
blocks.en: Although this section is brief, it echoes the core reminder of Section 3.4: ROI/financial analysis is only one input to the decision, and technical appropriateness must be confirmed first. However good the financial benefit, a system that is technically unsuitable for the intended use should not be adopted rashly. This again reflects the decision priority: (1) sterility assurance and product CQAs, then (2) technical appropriateness, then (3) business benefit (ROI).

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
（延續 Section 3.4 財務模型，適用於 5.1.4 之採購前 ROI 判斷）

ROI (%) = (預期淨效益 / 投資成本) × 100

決策時序：
  POC 確認技術可行 → 技術適用性分析 → ROI 商業論證
        → 最終設備選型與採購（定案）→ 正式啟動驗證 (Section 5.1.5 起)
blocks.en:
(Continuing the Section 3.4 financial model, applicable to the pre-purchase ROI judgment in 5.1.4)

ROI (%) = (expected net benefit / investment cost) × 100

Decision sequence:
  POC confirms technical feasibility → technical suitability analysis → ROI business justification
        → final equipment selection and purchase (decision made) → formal start of validation (Section 5.1.5 onward)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 以 Amaran 這類臨床階段無菌充填 CDMO 評估導入 AMM/RMM 為例，5.1.4 的 ROI 分析應建立在「技術已通過 POC」的前提上，具體流程可以是：
blocks.en: Taking a clinical-stage sterile filling CDMO such as Amaran evaluating an AMM/RMM as an example, the ROI analysis in 5.1.4 should be built on the premise that "the technology has passed POC". A specific workflow could be:

blocks.zh: 第一步（技術適用性）：POC 已確認新方法可偵測目標微生物、與客戶產品基質相容（見 5.1.1）
blocks.en: Step 1 (technical suitability): POC has confirmed that the new method can detect the target microorganisms and is compatible with the customer's product matrix (see 5.1.1)

blocks.zh: 第二步（財務論證，銜接 Section 3.4）：財務／營運部門依 Operating Costs、Investment Costs 與 Cost Savings/Avoidances 建立 ROI 或 Payback Period 模型，估算例如「批次放行時間由 14 天縮短至 2 天」對庫存持有成本與客戶交期承諾的具體效益
blocks.en: Step 2 (financial justification, linked to Section 3.4): Finance/operations build an ROI or payback period model based on operating costs, investment costs and cost savings/avoidances, estimating the specific benefit of, for example, "shortening batch release time from 14 days to 2 days" on inventory holding costs and customer delivery commitments

blocks.zh: 第三步（決策定案）：採購委員會依技術與財務雙重論證核准設備採購，此時的採購決策即鎖定了後續驗證的具體標的（設備型號、軟體版本）
blocks.en: Step 3 (decision made): The procurement committee approves the equipment purchase on the basis of both technical and financial justification; at this point the purchase decision locks in the specific target of subsequent validation (equipment model, software version)

blocks.zh: 第四步：採購定案後才正式啟動 URS 覆核、風險評估與驗證規劃（5.1.5 起）
blocks.en: Step 4: Only after the purchase is finalized do URS review, risk assessment and validation planning formally begin (5.1.5 onward)

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 管理層而言，這個順序也是向董事會或客戶說明「為何選擇這套系統」時最具說服力的敘事邏輯——先證明技術可行，再談財務效益，最後才拍板採購。
blocks.en: For CDMO management, this sequence is also the most persuasive narrative for explaining to the board or customers "why this system was chosen": first prove the technology is feasible, then discuss the financial benefit, and only then finalize the purchase.

blocks.zh: 為什麼原文強調「最終設備選型與採購應在驗證啟動之前完成」？如果驗證進行到一半才更換設備型號，會產生什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does the source stress that "final equipment selection and purchase should be completed before validation starts"? What problems arise if the equipment model is changed halfway through validation?

blocks.zh: 如果 POC 顯示某 AMM/RMM 技術可行，但 ROI 分析顯示投資回收期長達 8 年，你會如何向管理層呈現這個決策取捨？
blocks.en: If POC shows that an AMM/RMM technology is feasible but the ROI analysis shows a payback period of 8 years, how would you present this trade-off to management?

blocks.zh: 5.1.5 Risk Assessment and Validation Planning 風險評估與驗證規劃
blocks.en: 5.1.5 Risk Assessment and Validation Planning

blocks.zh: Risk Assessment 作為第一交付物：原文明確指出「the first deliverable of any validation exercise should be a documented risk assessment」——依循 QRM（品質風險管理，見 Section 3.5）原則，任何驗證活動的第一份正式文件就是風險評估，而非測試計畫本身。風險評估須具結構性、有文件紀錄，且投入程度須與 AMM/RMM 的預期用途及影響「相稱 (commensurate)」。
blocks.en: Risk assessment as the first deliverable: The source states explicitly that "the first deliverable of any validation exercise should be a documented risk assessment". Following the principles of QRM (quality risk management, see Section 3.5), the first formal document of any validation activity is the risk assessment, not the test plan itself. The risk assessment must be structured and documented, and the effort invested must be "commensurate" with the intended use and impact of the AMM/RMM.

blocks.zh: Validation Plan (驗證計畫)：風險評估完成後的下一步，是發展整體策略——驗證計畫。驗證計畫規範整個流程從頭到尾，明訂所需活動、驗證責任歸屬（哪些人/部門負責執行、審查、核准）,以及偏差（deviation）的處理、記錄、審查與核准機制。
blocks.en: Validation Plan: After the risk assessment is completed, the next step is to develop the overall strategy, namely the validation plan. The validation plan governs the whole process from start to finish, specifying the required activities, the assignment of validation responsibilities (who executes, reviews and approves), and the mechanism for handling, documenting, reviewing and approving deviations.

blocks.zh: 「先做風險評估、再訂驗證計畫」的順序，就像登山隊出發前先做風險地圖，再排定行程表：登山隊不會一開始就直接排「第一天走 20 公里、第二天攻頂」的行程，而是先評估天候、地形、隊員體能等風險因子，找出「哪些路段最危險、哪些環節最容易出狀況」，再依風險評估結果，反過來決定行程的節奏、需要準備的裝備、以及誰負責哪個環節（嚮導、醫護、後勤）。風險評估的深度與廣度，直接決定了驗證計畫（行程表）的範圍與嚴謹度。
blocks.en: The order "risk assessment first, validation plan second" is like a mountaineering team drawing up a risk map before setting the itinerary: the team does not start by scheduling "20 km on day one, summit on day two". It first assesses risk factors such as weather, terrain and team fitness, identifies "which sections are most dangerous and which steps are most likely to go wrong", and then, based on the risk assessment, decides the pace of the itinerary, the equipment to prepare, and who is responsible for each part (guide, medic, logistics). The depth and breadth of the risk assessment directly determine the scope and rigor of the validation plan (the itinerary).

blocks.zh: 原文特別強調驗證計畫必須明訂「how deviations ... are handled, documented, reviewed, and approved」——這是常被低估的一環。許多團隊在規劃驗證時只聚焦於「測試什麼」，卻沒有在計畫核准前就先定義好「萬一測試結果不如預期，該如何處理」的機制，導致驗證執行中一旦出現偏差，缺乏事先核准的路徑可循，往往需要額外變更程序才能繼續，拖延時程。此外，驗證責任有時會同時落在終端使用者與供應商身上——這點須在驗證計畫中明確分工，避免權責不清。
blocks.en: The source specifically emphasizes that the validation plan must define "how deviations ... are handled, documented, reviewed, and approved". This is an often underestimated element. Many teams focus only on "what to test" when planning validation and do not define, before the plan is approved, the mechanism for "what to do if the test results are not as expected". As a result, when a deviation occurs during execution there is no pre-approved path to follow, an extra change procedure is often needed to continue, and the schedule is delayed. In addition, validation responsibilities sometimes fall on both the end user and the supplier, so the validation plan must clearly divide the work to avoid unclear accountability.

blocks.zh: 為什麼風險評估的「投入程度」必須與 AMM/RMM 的「預期用途及影響」相稱？請舉一個高風險與低風險 AMM/RMM 應用的對比例子。
blocks.en: Why must the "level of effort" of the risk assessment be commensurate with the "intended use and impact" of the AMM/RMM? Give a contrasting example of a high-risk and a low-risk AMM/RMM application.

blocks.zh: 驗證計畫中「偏差處理機制」若未事先定義清楚，實務上可能造成哪些延誤？
blocks.en: If the deviation handling mechanism in the validation plan is not clearly defined in advance, what delays might this cause in practice?

blocks.zh: 如果驗證責任同時落在終端使用者與供應商身上，你會如何在驗證計畫中明確劃分雙方的角色與交付物？
blocks.en: If validation responsibilities fall on both the end user and the supplier, how would you clearly divide the roles and deliverables of each party in the validation plan?

blocks.zh: 5.1.6 Design Qualification 設計確效
blocks.en: 5.1.6 Design Qualification

blocks.zh: Design Qualification, DQ (設計確效)：針對設備或系統「設計本身」是否適合其預期用途（包含符合 GMP 要求）所進行的文件化審查與確認。DQ 是四大確效階段（DQ → IQ → OQ → PQ）中最早的一環，發生在採購與驗證之前。
blocks.en: Design Qualification, DQ: A documented review and confirmation that the design itself of the equipment or system is suitable for its intended use (including meeting GMP requirements). DQ is the earliest of the four qualification stages (DQ → IQ → OQ → PQ) and takes place before purchase and validation.

blocks.zh: Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS，商用現貨) 設備下的 DQ 定位轉變：原文特別點出：DQ 對「客製化設計、市面無現成產品」的設備最為關鍵；但絕大多數 AMM/RMM 系統屬於商用現貨設備，此時 DQ 的角色轉為驗證設備規格是否滿足 URS 所定義的需求，而非從頭審查工程設計圖。
blocks.en: How the role of DQ changes for commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) equipment: The source points out that DQ is most critical for equipment with a custom design for which no ready-made product exists on the market; but the great majority of AMM/RMM systems are commercial off-the-shelf equipment, and in that case the role of DQ becomes verifying that the equipment specifications meet the requirements defined in the URS, rather than reviewing the engineering drawings from scratch.

blocks.zh: DQ 就像裝潢前確認「這款現成家具是否符合你家的空間與需求規格」：如果你要訂做一套完全客製化的系統櫃（相當於客製化設計設備），設計圖審查（DQ）至關重要，因為根本沒有現成產品可比對。但如果你買的是市售的現成書櫃（相當於商用現貨的 AMM/RMM），DQ 的重點就不是重新審查書櫃的結構工程圖，而是核對「這款書櫃的尺寸、承重、材質是否符合你當初列出的需求規格（URS）」。
blocks.en: DQ is like checking before renovation that "this ready-made piece of furniture fits the space and specifications of your home": if you are ordering a fully customized built-in cabinet system (equivalent to custom-designed equipment), reviewing the design drawings (DQ) is essential because there is no existing product to compare against. But if you are buying an off-the-shelf bookcase (equivalent to a COTS AMM/RMM), DQ does not mean re-reviewing the structural engineering drawings of the bookcase; it means checking that "the size, load capacity and material of this bookcase meet the requirement specifications (URS) you originally listed".

blocks.zh: 原文提醒一個容易被誤解的地方：DQ 雖然名稱含有「Qualification（確效）」、也是確效流程的一部分，但DQ 活動通常發生在採購與驗證之前——這與一般人直覺認為「確效＝設備到貨後才開始」的印象不同。DQ 可由終端使用者或供應商執行，但終端使用者始終負有「驗證方法與伴隨系統是否符合 URS 要求」的最終責任，不能因為委託供應商執行 DQ 就免除這項責任。DQ 允收方式（供應商稽核、文件審查、直接檢視系統）需視儀器性質、應用複雜度、軟體複雜度及與供應商過往合作歷史而定。
blocks.en: The source warns of a point that is easily misunderstood: although DQ has "Qualification" in its name and is part of the qualification process, DQ activities usually take place before purchase and validation. This differs from the common impression that "qualification only starts once the equipment has arrived". DQ may be performed by the end user or the supplier, but the end user always retains ultimate responsibility for "verifying that the method and its accompanying system meet the URS requirements" and cannot be relieved of this responsibility by delegating the DQ to the supplier. The way DQ is accepted (supplier audit, document review, direct inspection of the system) depends on the nature of the instrument, the complexity of the application, the complexity of the software and the history of past dealings with the supplier.

blocks.zh: 為什麼原文說：即便 AMM/RMM 系統多為商用現貨設備，DQ 仍然「serves to verify」重要的功能？這與完全略過 DQ 有何不同？
blocks.en: Why does the source say that even though most AMM/RMM systems are commercial off-the-shelf equipment, DQ still "serves to verify" important functions? How does this differ from skipping DQ altogether?

blocks.zh: 如果供應商已執行過 DQ 並提供完整文件，終端使用者是否可以直接採用而不重複執行？決定的關鍵因素是什麼（提示：儀器性質、應用複雜度、與供應商過往合作歷史）？
blocks.en: If the supplier has already performed DQ and provided complete documentation, can the end user simply adopt it without repeating it? What are the key deciding factors (hint: nature of the instrument, complexity of the application, history of past dealings with the supplier)?

blocks.zh: DQ 與 URS 之間的關係為何？如果 URS 本身撰寫得不完整，DQ 的審查結果還能算是可靠嗎？
blocks.en: What is the relationship between DQ and the URS? If the URS itself is incomplete, can the DQ review results still be considered reliable?

blocks.zh: 5.1.7 The Validation Master Plan 驗證主計畫
blocks.en: 5.1.7 The Validation Master Plan

blocks.zh: Validation Master Plan, VMP (驗證主計畫)：包含開發研究的文件化路線圖（roadmap），涵蓋方法與伴隨系統的所有效能功能與需求，並明確指出將測試哪些項目以確保方法/系統的表現符合 URS 規格。VMP 是連結「URS 需求」與「實際測試執行」之間的橋樑。
blocks.en: Validation Master Plan, VMP: A documented roadmap of the development studies that covers all performance functions and requirements of the method and its accompanying system and clearly identifies what will be tested to ensure that the method/system performs according to the URS specifications. The VMP is the bridge between the "URS requirements" and the "actual test execution".

blocks.zh: VMP 涵蓋範圍：系統與方法功能性、組態設定（configuration）、輸入/輸出、環境條件、公用設施（utilities）、電腦與通訊架構、介面、資料管理與資安（security）。
blocks.en: Scope of the VMP: System and method functionality, configuration, inputs/outputs, environmental conditions, utilities, computer and communication architecture, interfaces, data management and security.

blocks.zh: VMP 與四大驗證階段的關係：各項效能功能/需求的具體測試腳本（test scripts）與允收標準，通常分別收錄在 VMP 所轄的相關階段中，即 IQ（安裝確效）、OQ（操作確效）、PQ（效能確效），以及 Method Validation（方法驗證，涵蓋 Method Suitability 與 Comparability）。
blocks.en: Relationship between the VMP and the four validation stages: The specific test scripts and acceptance criteria for each performance function/requirement are usually collected in the relevant stages under the VMP, namely IQ (installation qualification), OQ (operational qualification), PQ (performance qualification) and method validation (covering method suitability and comparability).

blocks.zh: VMP 就像一棟建築物的「總體施工計畫書」：URS 是屋主的需求清單（要幾房幾廳、要什麼建材），而 VMP 則是把這份需求清單轉化成具體的施工分期計畫——地基工程（相當於 IQ，確認安裝與公用設施到位）、結構與水電工程（相當於 OQ，確認各系統功能在操作範圍內正常運作）、最後的驗收使用測試（相當於 PQ 與 Method Validation，確認整棟房子在實際居住情境下持續穩定運作）。每個階段都有各自的檢驗腳本與允收標準，而 VMP 就是把這些檢驗項目依序、系統性地串起來的總綱。
blocks.en: The VMP is like the "master construction plan" for a building: the URS is the owner's list of requirements (how many rooms, which building materials), and the VMP turns this list into a phased construction plan: foundation work (equivalent to IQ, confirming installation and utilities are in place), structural and mechanical/electrical work (equivalent to OQ, confirming that each system functions properly across its operating range), and finally the acceptance and occupancy tests (equivalent to PQ and method validation, confirming that the whole building performs consistently under real living conditions). Each phase has its own inspection scripts and acceptance criteria, and the VMP is the master outline that strings these inspection items together in order and systematically.

blocks.zh: VMP 的撰寫者具有彈性——可以是終端使用者、供應商，或雙方共同撰寫，甚至可併入公司既有的其他驗證文件中，視企業自身的驗證要求或偏好而定。但無論由誰撰寫，VMP 的核心價值在於：它是唯一把「URS 規格要求」、「IQ/OQ/PQ 測試階段」與「Method Validation（含 Method Suitability、Comparability）」串接成單一、可追溯路線圖的文件——回顧 Table 5.0-1，VMP 正是驗證前活動（5.1）與後續設備/軟體確效（5.2）、方法驗證（5.3-5.4）之間承先啟後的樞紐。
blocks.en: The author of the VMP has flexibility: it can be the end user, the supplier, or both together, and it may even be incorporated into the company's other existing validation documents, depending on the company's own validation requirements or preferences. However, whoever writes it, the core value of the VMP is that it is the only document that links the "URS requirements", the "IQ/OQ/PQ test stages" and "method validation (including method suitability and comparability)" into a single traceable roadmap. Looking back at Table 5.0-1, the VMP is exactly the hinge between pre-validation activities (5.1) and the subsequent equipment/software qualification (5.2) and method validation (5.3-5.4).

blocks.zh: 對 Amaran 這類臨床階段無菌充填 CDMO 而言，撰寫一份 AMM/RMM 的 VMP 時，可依原文架構逐項對應：
blocks.en: For a clinical-stage sterile filling CDMO such as Amaran, when writing a VMP for an AMM/RMM, each item of the source structure can be mapped as follows:

blocks.zh: System/Method Functionality & Configuration：明訂設備各操作模式（例如定性 vs. 定量偵測模式）與組態設定範圍
blocks.en: System/Method Functionality & Configuration: Define the operating modes of the equipment (for example qualitative vs. quantitative detection modes) and the range of configuration settings

blocks.zh: Input/Outputs & Environmental Conditions：對應無菌充填廠房的環境條件（溫濕度、潔淨度分級）對儀器效能的潛在影響
blocks.en: Input/Outputs & Environmental Conditions: Address the potential effect on instrument performance of the environmental conditions in the sterile filling facility (temperature, humidity, cleanliness grade)

blocks.zh: Computer/Communication Architecture & Interfaces：規劃與 LIMS、電子批次紀錄（eBR）系統的介接方式，並納入 21 CFR Part 11 電子紀錄／簽章要求
blocks.en: Computer/Communication Architecture & Interfaces: Plan how the system will connect to LIMS and the electronic batch record (eBR) system, and include the 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for electronic records/signatures

blocks.zh: Data Management & Security：定義資料備份、稽核軌跡（audit trail）與存取權限管理，直接支持資料誠信（Data Integrity）要求
blocks.en: Data Management & Security: Define data backup, audit trail and access control management, directly supporting data integrity requirements

blocks.zh: IQ/OQ/PQ & Method Validation 分工：明確標示哪些測試腳本由供應商在現場安裝時完成（IQ 常見）、哪些由終端使用者在操作範圍測試時完成（OQ）、哪些需要以實際產品或替代分析物進行方法適用性與等效性驗證（PQ、Method Suitability、Comparability，對應 Section 5.2-5.4）
blocks.en: Division of IQ/OQ/PQ & Method Validation: State clearly which test scripts are completed by the supplier during on-site installation (commonly IQ), which are completed by the end user during operating range testing (OQ), and which require method suitability and equivalence/comparability testing with actual product or surrogate analytes (PQ, method suitability, comparability; corresponding to Sections 5.2-5.4)

blocks.zh: 對品質主管而言，VMP 也是稽核（無論是內部稽核或客戶稽核）時最常被要求出示的文件之一——它讓稽核員能一眼看出「這套 AMM/RMM 的驗證範圍是否完整涵蓋 URS 所有需求」，是展現驗證邏輯完整性的關鍵證據。
blocks.en: For the head of Quality, the VMP is also one of the documents most often requested during an audit (whether internal or customer): it lets the auditor see at a glance whether "the validation scope of this AMM/RMM fully covers all requirements in the URS", and is key evidence of the completeness of the validation logic.

blocks.zh: VMP 為何必須明確對應回 URS 中定義的需求？如果 VMP 遺漏了 URS 中某一項效能需求的測試規劃，會產生什麼稽核風險？
blocks.en: Why must the VMP clearly map back to the requirements defined in the URS? If the VMP omits the test planning for a performance requirement in the URS, what audit risk does this create?

blocks.zh: VMP 中提到的「computer and communication architecture, interfaces, data management, and security」，與 Section 5.2.3（Computer System Validation）之間存在什麼樣的先後與從屬關係？
blocks.en: What is the sequence and subordination between the VMP items "computer and communication architecture, interfaces, data management, and security" and Section 5.2.3 (Computer System Validation)?

blocks.zh: 如果 VMP 由供應商主筆撰寫，終端使用者的品質部門在審查時，應特別留意哪些可能被供應商「弱化」或忽略的項目（例如資料誠信、稽核軌跡)？
blocks.en: If the VMP is mainly written by the supplier, what items that the supplier might downplay or overlook (for example data integrity, audit trail) should the end user's Quality unit pay particular attention to when reviewing it?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 驗證應以生命週期 (lifecycle) 觀點進行，Table 5.0-1 提供整體驗證交付項目與供應商／終端使用者責任分工的總覽地圖（注意表格章節編號與本文小節標題間存在原文既有的一碼落差）
blocks.en: Validation should be approached from a lifecycle perspective. Table 5.0-1 gives an overview map of the overall validation deliverables and the division of responsibilities between supplier and end user (note the one-number discrepancy that already exists in the original document between the table's section numbers and the subsection headings in the text)

blocks.zh: 驗證前活動（5.1）依序為：POC（概念驗證，確認技術可行性）→ URS（使用者需求規格書，決定方法選型成敗並奠定驗證準則基礎）→ 供應商能力評估／稽核（含 Master File 機制）→ ROI 商業效益評估（延續 Section 3.4，須在設備選型/採購定案前完成）→ 風險評估與驗證規劃（QRM 為第一交付物，驗證計畫界定責任與偏差處理機制）→ DQ（設計確效，商用現貨設備下轉為驗證規格是否符合 URS）→ VMP（驗證主計畫，串接 URS 需求與 IQ/OQ/PQ、Method Validation 各階段測試腳本）
blocks.en: The pre-validation activities (5.1) are, in order: POC (proof of concept, confirming technical feasibility) → URS (user requirements specifications, which determine the success of method selection and lay the foundation for validation criteria) → supplier capability assessment/audit (including the Master File mechanism) → ROI business benefit assessment (continuing Section 3.4, to be completed before equipment selection/purchase is finalized) → risk assessment and validation planning (QRM as the first deliverable; the validation plan defines responsibilities and the deviation handling mechanism) → DQ (design qualification, which for COTS equipment becomes verifying that specifications meet the URS) → VMP (validation master plan, linking URS requirements to the test scripts of the IQ/OQ/PQ and method validation stages)

blocks.zh: URS 的完整度直接決定後續整個驗證策略與允收標準；DQ 與 VMP 皆須以 URS 為對照基準，確保設計與測試規劃完整覆蓋使用者需求
blocks.en: The completeness of the URS directly determines the entire subsequent validation strategy and acceptance criteria; DQ and the VMP must both use the URS as their reference, ensuring that the design and test planning fully cover the user requirements

blocks.zh: 設備選型與採購決策應在正式驗證啟動之前完成；ROI／財務分析僅是決策輸入之一，技術適用性與品質/法規論證優先於商業效益
blocks.en: Equipment selection and the purchase decision should be completed before formal validation starts; ROI/financial analysis is only one input to the decision, and technical appropriateness and quality/regulatory justification take priority over business benefit

blocks.zh: VMP 是承先啟後的樞紐文件，銜接驗證前活動（5.1）與後續設備/軟體確效（5.2）、方法驗證（5.3-5.4），也是稽核時展現驗證邏輯完整性的關鍵證據
blocks.en: The VMP is the hinge document linking what comes before and after it: it connects pre-validation activities (5.1) with the subsequent equipment/software qualification (5.2) and method validation (5.3-5.4), and is also key evidence of the completeness of the validation logic during audits
